datasheet_identity.title: NCE P-Channel Enhancement Mode Power MOSFET

extraction_notes: The canonical PDF identifies NCE3401AY as an NCE P-channel enhancement mode power MOSFET and shows revision v2.0.
P-channel voltage and current values are stored as magnitudes; signed source values are retained in the condition strings.
Typical, minimum, and maximum source_kind values follow the corresponding PDF table columns. RDS(on) values are converted from mΩ to Ω while retaining the published values in the conditions.

Curve points are approximate digitizations of visible target-specific traces. Curve identities, axis units, page references, and explicit temperatures are taken only from the canonical PDF; curve temperature is called not explicitly stated where the figure provides no temperature label.

The extraction focuses on electrical curves with clear axes and curve labels. The safe-operating-area and transient-thermal-impedance plots were not digitized because their multi-limit and thermal-network traces do not map cleanly to the schema's ordinary x/y curve representation.
omission_reason: Safe-operating-area and transient-thermal-impedance plots were not digitized; their multi-limit and thermal-network traces do not map cleanly to the schema's ordinary x/y curve representation.
